admin.title: Announcements
admin.subtitle: Post updates to the member Announcements feed. Telegram posts arrive automatically; use this to write desk notes by hand.
admin.bodyPlaceholder: Write your announcement. Line breaks are preserved.
admin.publishedHint: Unpublished announcements are hidden from members.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete this announcement? This cannot be undone.
admin.moderationSubtitle: Blocked words and links are rejected when a member tries to post. They never reach the feed. A built-in profanity filter is always on in addition to the rules below - it already catches swearing and its common disguises (f*ck, fuuuck, f.u.c.k), so you only need to add terms specific to your community.
admin.ruleDeleteConfirm: Remove this rule? Members will be able to post it again.
admin.commentsEmpty: No comments on this announcement yet.
admin.commentDeleteConfirm: This comment will disappear from the member feed. Replies to it are kept.
admin.muteModalBody: They will still be able to read comments, but cannot post or reply. This does not affect their account or platform access.
admin.blockedSubtitle: Comments the filter rejected before they reached the feed. The member was told their comment was blocked, but never which word or link caught it.
admin.mutesSubtitle: Muted members can read comments but cannot post. This is separate from a full account ban.
